summary: Frontend-only testing of the new holidays filter system (shared EgyptHolidays.jsx) across Thailand/Vietnam/Sri Lanka/Egypt/Singapore/Italy, legacy style URLs, mobile bottom-sheet, empty state, and 'Other <Country> holidays you may like' recommended section on Thailand/Vietnam/Egypt detail pages. 95%+ of acceptance criteria pass. One real routing bug surfaced: the Thailand product 'Luxury Bangkok and Pattaya Escape' links to /afrika/aegypten/... instead of /asien/... on both the Thailand holidays listing AND the Thailand detail Recommended section, because luxuryBangkokPattayaEscapeProduct is missing the `href: '/asien/...'` field while all other Thailand products in thailandToursData.js set it.

ui_bugs.issue: EgyptProductCard falls back to `/afrika/aegypten/${slug}` when `p.href` is missing. The Thailand product luxuryBangkokPattayaEscapeProduct (exported from /app/frontend/src/tours/luxuryBangkokPattayaEscapeData.js) does NOT set an `href` field, so its card on /asien/thailand/holidays and in the 'Other Thailand holidays you may like' section on Thailand detail pages links to `/afrika/aegypten/luxury-bangkok-and-pattaya-escape` (confirmed on /asien/best-of-phuket-krabi-bangkok Recommended grid and on the Thailand listing itself). All other Thailand products in thailandToursData.js include `href: '/asien/<slug>'`.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/tours/luxuryBangkokPattayaEscapeData.js add `href: '/asien/luxury-bangkok-and-pattaya-escape'` to the exported luxuryBangkokPattayaEscapeProduct object (parallel to the other Thailand products). After the fix, verify the Thailand holidays listing card and the 'Other Thailand holidays you may like' card both link to /asien/luxury-bangkok-and-pattaya-escape.
critical_code_review_comments: EgyptProductCard.jsx line 34 defaults to `/afrika/aegypten/${p.slug}` whenever `p.href` is undefined. Since this card is now reused across every country's holidays listing and every country's recommended section, any product missing its `href` silently generates an Egypt URL. Consider deriving the href from the product's country/region instead of defaulting to afrika/aegypten, or at least warn in dev when `p.href` is missing for non-Egypt products.

Recommended section in EgyptDetail.jsx correctly picks the pool via countryOf(slug) → productsOf(country) but inherits whatever href the product carries. A missing href propagates everywhere; a country-aware fallback here would make the data layer more forgiving.

Many eg-filter options and mhf-* options share the same data-testid value (hf-place-option, hf-days-option, mhf-price-option etc.) across multiple siblings, so Playwright/CI selectors must rely on text filters. Consider suffixing with the value (e.g. hf-place-option-phuket) for stable, unique selectors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed passing: (1) HTML5 <video> hero on /asien/thailand/holidays, /asien/vietnam/holidays, /asien/sri-lanka/holidays, /asien/singapore/holidays, /europa/italy/holidays (data-testid eg-holidays-video-file; no eg-holidays-video-iframe). Egypt /afrika/aegypten/holidays correctly keeps the Vimeo iframe (eg-holidays-video-iframe). h1s read '<Country> tours & holidays'. (2) Desktop sidebar sections Theme/Destination/Duration/Price with counts; 'All (20)' chip; eg-result-count '20 holidays'. Clicking place → ?place=Phuket, chip 'Destination: Phuket', count drops to 15, chip clear restores. Duration ?days=4-6 → 4 holidays all within range, Price ?price=20k-50k → all 7 cards' From-price inside bucket. Theme chip ?theme=Honeymoon → 6 cards; 'All' clears to ?-free URL. Sort pill → ?sort=price-asc, chip 'eg-filter-chip-sort', card prices ascending (₹31,840 / ₹33,564 / ₹36,783). Clear-all resets to base URL and 20 holidays. Faceted counts & disabling of 0-count options work. (3) Legacy /asien/thailand/holidays/honeymoon preselects theme Honeymoon with h1 'Thailand honeymoon holidays'; invalid slug /asien/thailand/holidays/invalid-xyz redirects to /asien/thailand/holidays. (4) Mobile 390px: eg-inline-filters-button opens mobile-filter-sheet; selecting mhf-days-option (4-6) updates apply text to 'Show 4 holidays' without URL change; applying navigates to ?days=4-6 and inline button shows active count '1'. After scroll>600px eg-mobile-cta + eg-mobile-filters-button appear. (5) Empty state via ?days=1-3&price=1l-plus renders eg-empty + eg-empty-clear which resets URL. (6) Recommended section titles correct per country: 'Other Thailand holidays you may like' on /asien/best-of-phuket-krabi-bangkok, 'Other Vietnam holidays you may like' on /asien/hanoi-sapa-5d4n, 'Other Egypt holidays you may like' on /afrika/aegypten/misr-maya-nile-cruise. ONLY ISSUE: on Thailand listing & Thailand recommended, the Luxury Bangkok and Pattaya Escape card links to /afrika/aegypten/luxury-bangkok-and-pattaya-escape — missing href on luxuryBangkokPattayaEscapeProduct. Zero console/page errors across tested pages (the Vimeo captcha 401 on preview is external and unrelated).
rca of the issue: EgyptProductCard.jsx line 34: `const to = p.href || (p.slug ? '/afrika/aegypten/${p.slug}' : null);`. The thailandProducts array includes `luxuryBangkokPattayaEscapeProduct` (/app/frontend/src/tours/luxuryBangkokPattayaEscapeData.js lines 279-294) which exports slug/title/price/images etc. but does NOT include `href`. All sibling Thailand products set `href: '/asien/<slug>'`. Because of the fallback, every surface that renders this product (Thailand holidays listing and Recommended on Thailand detail pages) emits an Egypt URL that would 404 or render the wrong detail page. Fix: add `href: '/asien/luxury-bangkok-and-pattaya-escape'` to the product export, matching sibling Thailand products.
